abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
conclusion: To sum up, the comparison of the groups shows the following. Overall, Brostamide and Standard care reach about the same blood pressure control. Overall, Brostamide improves systolic drop compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Brostamide is a water tablet that helps the body clear extra salt. All data for this comparison were collected at the Willow Lane Cohort.
